nodes.label: the passenger elevators
nodes.note: Six passenger elevator doors, three on each side of the core lobby, each jamb marked 14; call buttons between the doors. The lobby itself is not walked by the scan: it is seen through the glass double doors at one end; a wood door at the other end opens to the corridor. The glass doors have a card reader on the lobby side, a PUSH TO OPEN DOOR button on the suite side and the lettering THIS DOOR TO REMAIN UNLOCKED WHEN BUILDING IS OCCUPIED. Fire alarm pull station on the lobby wall just inside the glass doors. Whether the cars take a stretcher is not known from the scan.

nodes.label: the wood door at the end of the elevator lobby
nodes.note: Single wood door with a closer; wall sign ELEVATOR LOBBY on the corridor side. The same door is seen through the glass doors at the far end of the elevator lobby. Not known whether it locks from the lobby side.

nodes.label: the Stair A door
nodes.note: EXIT sign above, door plate STAIR A, wall sign STAIR A NO RE-ENTRY. Locked from the stair side is inferred from that sign, not seen.

approach.note: Stair A; sign beside the door reads NO RE-ENTRY, so expect the door to be locked from the stair side

glass double doors between the elevator lobby and the reception side: card reader on the lobby side, PUSH TO OPEN DOOR button on the suite side, lettering THIS DOOR TO REMAIN UNLOCKED WHEN BUILDING IS OCCUPIED; may be locked after hours

scope: 14th floor only: the whole floor around the central core. The elevator cars, both stairwells, the street-level lobby and every other floor are not scanned.
